# Patreon Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill that reads your Patreon creator data: identity (who owns the token), campaigns, members, and tiers. Read-only by construction — Patreon exposes no creator write endpoints, and the skill refuses any write request. Uses a Patreon Creator's Access Token, kept in Muse's secure vault. Draft: written from Patreon's public API v2 docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
